# A09-S140: Merchandise

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

I have made some The Synthetic Party merchandise in the same series as the Computer Lars outfit. That means it has different images and says DSP and/or The Synthetic Party, but with the same colors and likewise t-shirt, cap and mug.

That way we can have a “crew” that consists of the members, and who clearly are connected to me as party secretary.

It’s listed together in 2500, – for 5 sets plus transport. Is that okay?

[…]
